Introduction

AEONIT was a South Korean boy virtual idol group under ONMIND. The group consists of five members: Chanyu, Saebyeok, Yuan, Reon, and Wooju. They debuted on August 28, 2024, with their debut single album "LUMOS". The group uses motion capture technology to perform their idol activities.

Their name is a combination of the word “aeonian” which means for eternity and “emit” which means sending out light, sound, etc. It means that they will be sending out their own light and sound for their fans who give their love and support in order for them to exist.

ONMIND announced the termination of its contract with the members on July 31, marking the end of group activities following their last comeback in August.
